title: Planet words you use every day
caption: Jovial, mercurial, saturnine, lunatic, influenza: all named for the sky.

beats.head: Your *mood* words come from the planets.
*Jovial:* born under Jupiter, the cheerful king of the gods.
*Mercurial:* quick and changeable, like fast little Mercury.
*Saturnine:* slow, serious, a little gloomy. Thanks, Saturn.
*Lunatic* comes from luna, the Moon.
beats.sub: People once blamed odd behavior on its phases.

beats.head: And *influenza* meant the stars' influence.
beats.sub: Italians once blamed outbreaks on the sky.

beats.head: Find someone who loves you *jovial* and saturnine.
beats.sub: Mercurial moods included. Send this to them.
